caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate goblet or chalice. The goblet features a wide, rounded cup that narrows at the stem and then flares out to a broad, circular base. The main color of the goblet is a pale, beige or cream tone. The surface is decorated with blue and gold patterns: the cup is adorned with stylized, symmetrical blue leaf or petal motifs, each bordered with gold lines, and interspersed with small gold and blue dots. The base is similarly decorated with elongated blue areas outlined in gold, as well as additional blue and gold dots. The rim and the edge of the base are highlighted with gold, suggesting a metallic finish. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light beige wash.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
